title: FAIR-CI: fairness in local energy systems
text: My research project FAIR-CI is supported by FCT through the Individual Call to Scientific Employment Stimulus (CEECIND), 7th Edition. In May 2026, I started a new position as Auxiliary Researcher at ISEP.

title: Strategic bidding in local electricity markets
text: Our article on strategic bidding with distributed resources and grid constraints is available in Sustainable Energy, Grids and Networks. With Tayenne Dias de Lima, Fabio Castro and Zita Vale.

title: Associate Editor of Artificial Intelligence Review
text: I joined the editorial team of Artificial Intelligence Review as an Associate Editor.

title: IEEE Senior Member recognition
text: I received IEEE Senior Member recognition in December 2023.
